name: openpixo/toon-3d
title: Toon-shaded 3D
description: Stepped ramp lighting, clean ink outlines and chunky friendly forms for bright stylized 3D adventures.

description_i18n.en: Stepped ramp lighting, clean ink outlines and chunky friendly forms for bright stylized 3D adventures.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 阶梯式色阶光照、干净的描边和敦实友好的造型，适合明亮的风格化 3D 冒险游戏。

examples.title: Island explorer
examples.prompt: Generate an original island explorer character concept using the toon-3d art style: oversized satchel, rolled-up trousers, a compass on a cord and a short wooden staff. Use a neutral three-quarter pose, two-tone ramp shading and consistent outlines.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 toon-3d 美术风格生成原创海岛探险者角色概念：超大挎包、卷起的裤腿、挂绳指南针和短木杖。采用中性的四分之三姿势、双色阶明暗和统一粗细的描边。

examples.title: Cliffside lighthouse
examples.prompt: Create a cliffside lighthouse level prop concept using the toon-3d art style, with a chunky striped tower, a wooden stair path and a few rounded bushes. Keep shapes simple, outlines even and the sky bright and open.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 toon-3d 美术风格制作悬崖灯塔关卡道具概念：敦实的条纹塔身、木质台阶小路和几丛圆润灌木。造型简洁，描边均匀，天空明亮开阔。

style.prompt: Real-time stylized 3D game render of rounded, volumetric polygon models lit by a toon shader: stepped two- or three-tone ramp lighting with crisp shadow terminators, post-process ink outlines of consistent screen-space width around every silhouette, chunky simplified proportions and flat painted-color textures. Visible 3D depth, perspective and form-following cast shadows, saturated but balanced colors from the shared palette, a soft rim light, minimal specular highlights and a bright open sky. Keep shapes bold and readable from a gameplay camera with a cheerful adventure tone; it must read as a 3D engine scene, not a flat 2D drawing.
style.negativePrompt: flat 2D illustration, hand-drawn anime drawing, photorealism, realistic PBR materials, noisy high-frequency textures, smooth gradient shading, soft blurry shadows, missing or uneven outlines, gritty grime, desaturated palette, heavy bloom, glossy plastic, text, logo, watermark

constraints.outline: Even dark screen-space outline around every silhouette; thinner interior lines.
